>> Mayor Adler: All right. So we are -- time is 12:15 we're going to convene our meeting on June 22, 
2016. This is a special called meeting. It is a special called meeting for the purpose of going into 
executive session. So we can't do anything other than call this meeting, go into executive session. At the 
end of executive session we can't do anything but come out of executive session and end the meeting so 
today's meeting will all be in executive session. The city council will go into closed session to take up one 
item pursuant to 551.074 government code of city council will discuss the following personnel item, 
evaluate the performance of and consider compensation benefits for the city manager. Is there any 
objection to going into executive session on the item announced? >> Mr. Mayor? I'd like to be 
recognized for the purpose of making a motion that we postpone this agenda item until August. And if I 
get a second I'll explain why. My motion is to postpone this meeting today until August. >> Mayor Adler: 
Do we have the ability to be able to do that? If we're posted to go into executive session -- I guess it's 
always in order to postpone a meeting. Okay. It's been moved to postpone the meeting for today. Is 
there a second to that motion is? Ms. Garza sending that motion. >> Zimmerman: For purposes of 
discussion? Okay, so there's been quite a bit of buzz about the letter that the city manager released that 
he's being considered for a position that might be named as soon as the middle of next month. That's 
just a few weeks from now. And in the interest of that, I would like us to not immediately consider any 
performance or compensation matters until that issue has

had a chance to play out. That's really the reason, just to not have a calendar timing issue with that 
pretty important decision that might come in the middle of next month. That's really the only reason. >> 
Mayor Adler: Yes, Ms. Garza. >> Garza: I don't want to put the city manager on the spot but I wonder if
